resources.string: No browser is installed to open the source page.
Next refresh allowed at %1$s. Saved photos remain available.
Could not update photos. Saved photos remain available; bundled landscapes are used if needed. Check your connection and available TV storage.

Wikimedia Commons supplies nature scenes; NASA supplies space images. No account or API key is needed. Requests go only to the selected providers. Downloads stop when you leave the launcher or this screen. Photos are resized to at most 1080p and old collections are replaced. Credits and license details are available in previews. The last 10,000 photo IDs are remembered to avoid repeats; clearing photos also clears this history.
Show credits on the wallpaper. Full credits and source details always remain available in Preview downloaded photos.
